visual_enhancers.badges: Pill shape, font-semibold, text-xs with semantic background (emerald-100/emerald-800 for Baik/Sesuai, amber-100/amber-800 for Rusak Ringan/Menipis, rose-100/rose-800 for Rusak Berat/Habis)
visual_enhancers.kpi_cards: Crisp 1px border with border-slate-200/80, subtle hover -translate-y-0.5 transition, distinct top colored indicator strip (emerald, sky, amber, rose)
visual_enhancers.tables: Sticky table header, zebra striping on demand, compact text-sm padding, action buttons grouped with tooltip and explicit data-testid
visual_enhancers.modals: Dialog with max-w-2xl or max-w-4xl for forms, clear section separators, auto-calculated subtotal fields with highlight
visual_enhancers.print_kop: Official Indonesian School Letterhead (KOP SURAT) with dual emblem logo, school name bold uppercase, complete NPSN, address, contact, and divider double-line (garis ganda tebal tipis)

motion.page_transitions: Fade in with opacity 0 to 1 and translateY 6px over 0.2s ease-out

accessibility.contrast_ratio: All body and label texts exceed 4.5:1 against their respective card and page surfaces
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Full tab index support on modals, data tables, and dropdowns
accessibility.data_test_ids: Enforced kebab-case role-based test IDs across all clickable, input, and stat elements

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Greet the Indonesian school operator user with a professional, clean, highly functional UI (SIMBARA SEKOLAH).
2. All labels, menus, tooltips, validation messages, and reports must be in clear, natural Bahasa Indonesia.

3. Seed rich realistic mock/initial data covering: 2 roles (Admin: admin / admin123, Pengurus: pengurus / pengurus123), 20+ Master Barang (ATK, Meubelair, Elektronik, Kebersihan), 15+ Barang Masuk & Keluar, Realtime Kartu Stok, 5+ Stok Opname records, 13 Laporan yang siap cetak & export, Profil SMP Negeri 1 Teladan lengkap.

4. Ensure formulas run accurately: Stok Akhir = Stok Awal + Masuk - Keluar. Barang Masuk Total Harga = Jumlah x Harga Satuan. Barang Keluar validates against available stock. Stok Opname calculates Selisih = Fisik - Sistem.
5. For Excel import/export: use xlsx/csv export in frontend and openpyxl/pandas in backend; provide sample template download button for operators.
6. Printable reports must look like official government/school administrative documents with Kop Sekolah, NPSN, nomor laporan, and signature blocks (Mengetahui: Kepala Sekolah & Pengurus Barang).
7. Include demo quick-login buttons on the login screen ('Masuk sebagai Admin' & 'Masuk sebagai Pengurus Barang') for effortless testing and immediate evaluation.
8. Implement responsive mobile layout: drawer sidebar on small screens, scrollable data tables with sticky column headers.
